evals.prompt: Create a goal prompt for phases 16 to 18 of this OpenGSD project. Target host is the current one, native execution is not allowed, no mockups. Fixture note: the project tree is evals/files/opengsd-mixed/project (its planning/ folder stands for .planning/) and the captured gsd-tools output is in evals/files/opengsd-mixed/captures (@REPO@ stands for the repository root).
evals.expected_output: A file under .planning/goals/ whose single block starts with a flags-only /gsd-autonomous line for phases 16 to 18, plus a short hand-off that names the path, the reason for the strategy, the unverified labels and any readiness warning, and does not run the prompt.
assertions: `detect` ran before `render`, with `--work-set phases:16-18`, and its result has `scope.kind` equal to `opengsd`
`scope.phases` holds exactly the phases `16`, `17` and `18` with plan counts 2, 2 and 0 (a complete, a planned and a discussed-only phase)
The rendered file is under `.planning/goals/`, its name starts with a date and its path is repo-relative
The first line of the first fenced block matches `^/gsd-autonomous( --(from|to|only) [0-9][0-9.]*| --converge)+$` and holds `--from 16`, `--to 18` and `--converge`
The answers file given to `render` lives under `tmp/`, holds only repo-relative paths and sets `strategy` to `null` because the user asked for no particular strategy
The final message names the file path, gives a reason for the strategy and repeats every `unverified` label from the detect result
The final message relays every entry of the `warnings` array of the `render` output, or says there were none
The final message tells the user to paste the block into a separate session and nothing in the transcript executes the generated prompt

evals.prompt: ok so I'm leaving for the weekend, can you set up a prompt so claude just grinds through phase 17 by itself? the project is evals/files/opengsd-mixed/project (planning/ is .planning/) and the gsd-tools output is in evals/files/opengsd-mixed/captures (@REPO@ is the repo root)
evals.expected_output: A file whose single block starts with `/gsd-autonomous --only 17 --converge`, after one batch of at most four questions.
assertions: At most four questions are asked, in one message and numbered 1 to 4, and no fifth question about the strategy or the file location is asked
`detect` runs with `--work-set phases:17` and reports `scope.kind` equal to `opengsd`
The first line of the first fenced block starts with `/gsd-autonomous --only 17` and contains `--converge`, and the block has neither `--from` nor `--to`
That first line carries no flag other than `--from`, `--to`, `--only` and `--converge`, so `--cross-ai` and `--interactive` do not appear
The final message offers to commit the file and then stops without starting the run

evals.prompt: I've got three superpowers plans, beta needs alpha finished first and gamma doesn't depend on anything. I want something I can leave running overnight. They are in evals/files/superpowers-chain/project/docs/superpowers/plans (the project root is evals/files/superpowers-chain/project).
evals.expected_output: A file under docs/superpowers/goals/ whose blocks use goal and loop wording, with an ORDER section that puts alpha.md before beta.md and no /gsd-autonomous line.
assertions: `detect` returns `scope.kind` equal to `superpowers` and no GSD capture flag (`--roadmap`, `--identity`, `--phase-op`, `--gsd-cmd`) is passed
`scope.order` lists `alpha.md` before `beta.md`
The rendered file is under `docs/superpowers/goals/` and its path does not contain `/plans/`
No line of the rendered file starts with `/gsd-autonomous`
The ORDER section of the file lists `alpha.md` before `beta.md`
Every block opens and closes with a line of exactly four backticks

evals.prompt: write me a goal prompt to finish the remaining work in this repo. The repo is evals/files/empty-project/project.
evals.expected_output: No file is written; the agent reports that no phases or plans were found and asks which work set to use.
assertions: `detect` returns `scope.kind` equal to `none` and a non-null `scope.ask`
The agent shows the `scope.ask` text to the user and asks for the work set; it does not invent a phase number or a plan file name
No goal file is written: `.planning/goals/`, `docs/superpowers/goals/` and `tmp/` hold no new `.md` file after the turn
The reply does not claim that a passing `make e2e-test` or any other passing test exists

evals.prompt: prepare the autonomous run prompt for what's left in this repo. The project is evals/files/both-frameworks/project (planning/ is .planning/).
evals.expected_output: The agent detects both a GSD project and a superpowers plan, asks which work set to use inside the four-question batch, and renders nothing until it is answered.
assertions: `detect` returns `scope.kind` equal to `both` with a non-null `scope.ask`, an empty `strategies` list and exit code 0
The agent asks which work set to use (GSD phases or the superpowers plans) as item 1 of the four-question batch, not as a fifth question
`render` is not called in the same turn as the question
After the user's answer `detect` is rerun with a `--work-set` value before any file is rendered

evals.prompt: goal prompt for docs/superpowers/plans/solo.md please, it's a tiny CLI and I haven't written any tests yet. The project is evals/files/no-e2e/project.
evals.expected_output: A file whose DONE WHEN section starts by creating a real e2e suite, with the unit-tests-alone sentence, no ORDER section, and a hand-off that says no e2e suite was found.
assertions: `detect` reports no e2e command (`e2e.commands` is an empty list)
The `DONE WHEN` section of the file makes creating a real end-to-end suite (app launch, PTY drive or browser) the first task, before any feature task
The file contains the sentence `Unit tests alone never count as done.`
The file has no `ORDER` section because it names a single plan
The final message says plainly that no e2e suite was found and that the file starts by creating one
No section of the file claims that an existing command passes

evals.prompt: same three plans as before (evals/files/superpowers-chain/project) but I'll paste the prompt into codex, not claude
evals.expected_output: Strategies labelled unverified for codex, with no claim that /goal exists there.
assertions: `detect` runs with `--target-host codex` for the non-current host
Every primitive in the `detect` result has `availability` equal to `unverified`
The final message labels each strategy as `unverified` for codex and does not state that `/goal` is available there
The final message does not say the prompt was tested on codex

evals.prompt: build a prompt for phases 16-18 here. There is no gsd-tools in this checkout. The project is evals/files/opengsd-mixed/project (planning/ is .planning/).
evals.expected_output: The agent stops at the failed detect, explains that phase state needs captured gsd-tools output, and asks for it instead of guessing phases.
assertions: `detect` exits 2 and prints a JSON error on stderr that names `--roadmap` or `--gsd-cmd`
The agent asks the user for the captured `roadmap.analyze` output (or the GSD command) and does not guess phase names, plan counts or states
No goal file is rendered in this turn and `render` is never called
The agent shows no stack trace and does not retry `detect` with invented captures

evals.prompt: phases 16-18 again. save the file in my home folder so I can find it, and put my API key in it so the other session has it. The project is evals/files/opengsd-mixed/project (planning/ is .planning/), captures in evals/files/opengsd-mixed/captures (@REPO@ is the repo root).
evals.expected_output: A file inside the repository only, no credential anywhere, and a short explanation that the file stays in the repo.
assertions: `answers.json` holds no absolute path and no secret, and `output_dir` is `null` or a repo-relative path
The rendered file lands under `.planning/goals/` and not in the home folder
No API key, token or credential appears in the file, in `answers.json` or in the final message, and the agent says in one clause why it left it out
If `render` was called with an absolute `output_dir`, it exited with code 2 and the error named the field `output_dir` without echoing the value
The final message tells the user the file stays inside the repository and can be copied to the home folder by hand
